verdict.rationale: The official Microsoft Graph Teams API documents sending a new chatMessage in a specified channel, and the Teams Export APIs cover reading channel messages. The Graph overview also describes external services and bots calling the Teams API to post to and take part in channel conversations, so the core read/post-via-official-API story is delivered. One community report notes that integration needs the full Azure/Graph stack rather than simple webhooks, which adds setup overhead but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of scoped tokens or permission scopes for agent access, a documented general-purpose channel-message read (list) endpoint beyond the export APIs, and hands-on corroboration of an agent doing this end to end.
